description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter class, a custom filter component for Ext JS 3.3.0 that provides list filtering capabilities in a grid, utilizing Ext.data.Store and Ext.ux.menu.ListMenu.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter
classes.description: A grid filter class that allows filtering based on a list of options, with support for local and remote data sources, and configurable via options and phpMode.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, creates the ListMenu, and sets up event handling.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the currently selected filter values from the ListMenu.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the selected values in the ListMenu and triggers an update event.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter has enough configuration to be activated based on current selection.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter data for server transmission, formatted according to phpMode.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Handles check change events in the ListMenu, delaying the update.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the current filter selection.
